title: HTT-Net: Hierarchical Text-guided Transition Modeling for Surgical Video Phase Recognition
summary: Surgical video phase recognition is a fundamental task in computer-assisted intervention, supporting workflow understanding, intraoperative guidance, and surgical quality assessment. Although recent visual-temporal models have achieved promising progress, accurate and temporally coherent phase recognition remains challenging due to local visual ambiguity, transient prediction noise, and insufficient use of procedural semantics. To address these challenges, we propose HTT-Net, a Hierarchical Text-guided Transition modeling Network for surgical video phase recognition. The key idea is to introduce structured surgical semantic knowledge into phase-aware segment construction and semantic refinement. Specifically, we construct a hierarchical surgical semantic memory with intra-phase descriptions, inter-phase transition descriptions, and fine-grained semantic units. Based on this memory, the proposed Transition-Aware Segment Construction (TAS-Con) organizes frame-level evidence into coherent segment representations and handles boundary clips with inter-phase transition descriptions. Furthermore, we introduce Transition-Aware Segment Calibration (TAS-Calib), which calibrates phase-aware segment representations through hierarchical surgical semantics and improves discrimination under visual ambiguity without dense frame-level vision-language fusion. Experiments on Cholec80 and LCRS-100 demonstrate the effectiveness of HTT-Net for robust surgical video phase recognition.
tldr: Proposes HTT-Net, a hierarchical text-guided network for surgical video phase recognition, using intra-phase and inter-phase descriptions to improve segment construction and calibration, achieving robust results on Cholec80 and LCRS-100.
tldr_zh: 提出HTT-Net，一种分层文本引导的手术视频阶段识别网络，利用阶段内和阶段间描述改进片段构建与校准，在Cholec80和LCRS-100上取得鲁棒结果。
summary_zh: 手术视频阶段识别是计算机辅助干预中的一项基础任务，支持工作流程理解、术中引导和手术质量评估。尽管最近的视觉-时序模型取得了显著进展，但由于局部视觉模糊、瞬态预测噪声以及程序语义利用不足，准确且时序连贯的阶段识别仍然面临挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了HTT-Net，一种用于手术视频阶段识别的层次化文本引导的过渡建模网络。其核心思想是将结构化的手术语义知识引入阶段感知的片段构建和语义优化中。具体而言，我们构建了一个层次化手术语义记忆库，包含阶段内描述、阶段间过渡描述以及细粒度语义单元。基于该记忆库，所提出的过渡感知片段构建（TAS-Con）将帧级证据组织为连贯的片段表示，并利用阶段间过渡描述处理边界片段。此外，我们引入了过渡感知片段校准（TAS-Calib），通过层次化手术语义校准阶段感知片段表示，在无需密集帧级视觉-语言融合的情况下，提升视觉模糊条件下的判别能力。在Cholec80和LCRS-100上的实验证明了HTT-Net在鲁棒的手术视频阶段识别中的有效性。

title: OFD-Net: Teacher-Free Reliable Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation with Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement Net of Foreground-Background
summary: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) is an effective solution for medical image segmentation with limited annotations. Existing SSL methods mainly rely on pseudo-labels generated by teacher-student supervision or cross-network consistency. However, these methods lack an explicit structural reference for judging pseudo-label quality. Low-quality pseudo-labels may lead to unreliable training, error accumulation and confirmation bias when processing unlabeled data with substantial appearance variations. To address this issue, we proposed OFD-Net, a teacher-free single-network framework for reliable semi-supervised medical image segmentation. OFD-Net employs an Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement Module (OFDM) to capture OFD features for reliable SSL by disentangling unlabeled data into background and foreground representations with a reliable structural distribution, thereby effectively reducing error accumulation and alleviating confirmation bias among unlabeled data. Specifically, OFD-Net explicitly employs a Disentanglement Guidance Module (DGM) to inject the resulting structural priors of foreground-background into the decoder by deformable convolution processing, and outputs predictions with clearer foreground representations. Based on DGM and the OFDM, we further develop a reliability-aware pseudo-label learning mechanism that evaluates unlabeled supervision according to the structural consistency between the main prediction and the disentangled foreground-background responses, and then down-weights unreliable regions during training. Extensive experiments on four public medical image segmentation benchmarks, namely ISIC-2016, Kvasir-SEG, Synapse, and ACDC, validate the effectiveness of OFD-Net. These results confirm that orthogonal foreground-background disentanglement enables OFD-Net to establish an efficient and reliable training paradigm within a teacher-free single-network framework.
tldr: OFD-Net proposes a teacher-free single-network framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation, using orthogonal feature disentanglement to separate foreground and background, improving pseudo-label reliability and reducing error accumulation.
tldr_zh: OFD-Net提出了一种无教师单网络半监督医学图像分割框架，通过正交特征解耦分离前景与背景，提高伪标签可靠性并减少误差累积。
summary_zh: 半监督学习（SSL）是解决医学图像分割中标注稀缺问题的有效方案。现有SSL方法主要依赖教师-学生监督或跨网络一致性生成的伪标签。然而，这些方法缺乏用于判断伪标签质量的显式结构参考。在处理外观变化显著的无标注数据时，低质量伪标签可能导致不可靠训练、误差累积及确认偏差。针对该问题，我们提出了OFD-Net——一种无需教师网络的单框架可靠半监督医学图像分割方法。OFD-Net采用正交特征解耦模块（OFDM），通过将无标注数据解耦为具有可靠结构分布的背景与前景表征，捕获OFD特征以实现可靠的SSL，从而有效减少误差累积并缓解无标注数据中的确认偏差。具体而言，OFD-Net显式地使用解耦指导模块（DGM），通过可变形卷积处理将所得前景-背景结构先验注入解码器，并输出具有更清晰前景表征的预测结果。基于DGM与OFDM，我们进一步开发了一种可靠性感知的伪标签学习机制，该机制根据主预测与解耦的前景-背景响应之间的结构一致性评估无标注监督的质量，进而在训练过程中对不可靠区域进行降权处理。在四个公开医学图像分割基准（即ISIC-2016、Kvasir-SEG、Synapse和ACDC）上的大量实验验证了OFD-Net的有效性。这些结果证实，正交前景-背景解耦使OFD-Net能够在无需教师网络的单框架中建立高效可靠的训练范式。

title: A Research Prototype for Closed-Loop Generative Design of Customized Foot Orthoses via Semantic-Physics Alignment
summary: Translating unstructured clinical prescriptions into patient-specific foot orthoses (FOs) is hindered by a semantic-physical misalignment: high-level clinical intent is not mapped deterministically onto the 3D geometric parameters of the orthosis, and existing design workflows remain dependent on manual expertise with no instantaneous biomechanical validation. We present TANS-FO, a research prototype-a modular pipeline with closed-loop feedback for computational design automation of customized FOs, not a clinically validated therapeutic device. A Text-Aligned Neural Surrogate (TANS) uses cross-attention to project clinical-text embeddings onto a continuous lattice-density field, while a Graph Neural Network (GNN) surrogate predicts plantar stress in real time as a substitute for Finite Element Analysis (FEA). The framework is anchored on the open-access PicoFoot-5K anthropometric database (5,230 subjects; 30+ anatomical parameters). Under standardized quasi-static loading, the GNN surrogate agrees with an Abaqus reference solver (R^2 = 0.94), and the full pipeline synthesizes manufacturing-ready lattice insoles within minutes. On the Male 18-40 cohort, the proposed system attains a surrogate-predicted peak-pressure reduction of 34.7% over parametric CAD, with a fit error of 0.42 mm. Separately, an exploratory feasibility observation (n = 12; 2-week follow-up; no control group) using VAS pain reporting indicates short-term comfort improvement (VAS 6.4 -> 2.1), but this data is explicitly classified as preliminary observational evidence only-not evidence of clinical efficacy.
tldr: TANS-FO is a prototype pipeline that uses a text-aligned neural surrogate and GNN to automate the design of customized foot orthoses from clinical descriptions, achieving real-time biomechanical prediction and significant pressure reduction, but with only preliminary clinical observations.
tldr_zh: TANS-FO 是一个原型流水线，利用文本对齐的神经代理和 GNN 从临床描述自动化设计定制足部矫形器，实现实时生物力学预测和显著的足底压力降低，但临床观察仅为初步探索。
summary_zh: 将非结构化临床处方转化为患者专用足部矫形器（FO）的过程，受到语义-物理错位的阻碍：高级别的临床意图无法确定性映射到矫形器的三维几何参数，且现有设计工作流仍依赖人工经验，缺乏即时生物力学验证。本文提出TANS-FO——一个研究原型，即带有闭环反馈的模块化流水线，用于定制化足部矫形器的计算设计自动化，而非经临床验证的治疗设备。文本对齐神经代理（TANS）利用交叉注意力将临床文本嵌入投影到连续网格密度场，而图神经网络（GNN）代理则实时预测足底应力，作为有限元分析（FEA）的替代方案。该框架基于开放获取的PicoFoot-5K人体测量数据库（5230名受试者；30余项解剖参数）。在标准化准静态加载条件下，GNN代理与Abaqus参考求解器的一致性良好（R² = 0.94），完整流水线可在数分钟内合成可制造的网格鞋垫。在男性18-40岁队列中，与参数化CAD相比，所提系统实现代理预测的峰值压力降低34.7%，贴合误差为0.42 mm。此外，一项探索性可行性观察（n=12；2周随访；无对照组）采用VAS疼痛报告显示短期舒适度改善（VAS从6.4降至2.1），但该数据明确归类为仅初步观察证据——而非临床疗效证据。

title: Can Experts Adapt Without Training? On Test-Time Modality Generalization in MVLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (MVLMs) promise broad zero-shot generalization, yet their reliability collapses when confronted with unseen modalities and domains, precisely where clinical robustness matters most. To address this gap, we revisit test-time modality generalization from the perspective of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and ask: can experts route-and-adapt without any optimization during inference? We identify a fundamental specialization-generalization dilemma at test time, where blindly aggregating modality experts dilutes modality-specific knowledge, while selecting one highly confident expert risks mismatch under shift. To address this, we propose MoBE: a fully optimization-free framework that performs dynamic expert selection and adaptation at test time. MoBE combines entropy-guided dynamic routing in MoE settings with expert-wise Bayesian adaptation, enabling experts to update their confidence and adapt online without gradient updates. Without parametric updates, MoBE augments a static MVLM with test-time routing and online statistics, achieving average accuracy gains of +4.72, +7.17, and +4.3 over state-of-the-art TTA methods across seen, unseen, and heterogeneous medical benchmarks, highlighting the effectiveness of training-free expert adaptation for robust modality generalization.
tldr: This paper proposes MoBE, a training-free framework for test-time modality generalization in medical vision-language models (MVLMs) that uses entropy-guided dynamic routing and Bayesian adaptation to improve robustness across seen, unseen, and heterogeneous medical benchmarks without gradient updates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MoBE，一种无需训练即可在医学视觉语言模型（MVLM）中实现测试时模态泛化的框架，通过熵引导动态路由和贝叶斯适应，在不进行梯度更新的情况下提高了在已见、未见和异构医学基准上的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 医学视觉语言模型（MVLMs）在零样本泛化方面展现出广阔前景，但其在面对未见模态和领域时可靠性急剧下降，而恰恰是这些场景对临床鲁棒性最为关键。为解决这一不足，我们从混合专家（MoE）的视角重新审视测试时模态泛化问题，并提出问题：专家能否在推理过程中无需任何优化即可实现路由与自适应？我们发现在测试时存在一个根本性的专业化-泛化困境：盲目聚合模态专家会稀释模态特定知识，而选择单一高置信度专家则可能在分布偏移下导致失配风险。为此，我们提出MoBE：一种完全免优化的框架，可在测试时执行动态专家选择与自适应。MoBE将MoE设置中的熵引导动态路由与专家级贝叶斯自适应相结合，使专家能够在无需梯度更新的情况下在线更新其置信度并进行自适应。在不进行参数更新的前提下，MoBE通过测试时路由和在线统计增强静态MVLM，在已知、未知及异质性医学基准测试中，相较于最先进的TTA方法分别实现了+4.72、+7.17和+4.3的平均准确率提升，凸显了免训练专家自适应在实现稳健模态泛化方面的有效性。

title: DS@GT ARC at eRisk 2026: Hybrid Multi-Agent LLM System with Structured Algorithmic Guidance for Conversational Depression Screening
summary: We describe DS@GT's submission to the eRisk 2026 Task 1 challenge on conversational depression screening, in which systems interview LLM personas that simulate individuals with varying depression profiles and produce a Beck Depression Inventory II (BDI-II) score plus four key symptoms per persona, without directly asking sensitive mental health questions. Our pipeline evolved through three stages: a monolithic single-model prototype to start off, a baseline multi-agent architecture that separates conversational interviewing from BDI-II scoring under a coordinating orchestration layer, and a final hybrid configuration that replaces the paid GPT-5-nano interviewer with the open-source Gemma 27B. To offset the model's weaker reasoning and instruction-following, the hybrid adds three algorithmic components: a precomputed dialogue tree that standardizes interview openers and follow-ups, a reliability-weighted consensus aggregation inspired by the Weaver framework, and a cluster-based imputation step for unprobed symptoms. We submitted three fully automated runs across all 20 personas, with Run 1 from the paid baseline and Runs 2 and 3 from the hybrid. Hybrid Run 3 achieved an ADODL of 0.9063, ranking 3rd among all complete-submission runs and placing DS@GT 2nd among the 21 teams overall, while outperforming our paid baseline Run 1 (0.8841) at roughly one-quarter of the per-persona API cost. These results support our central hypothesis that with sufficient algorithmic supervision, a weaker open-source model can compete with a stronger proprietary model in the conversational interviewer role. Our source code is available at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/erisk-task1-2026.
tldr: The paper presents a hybrid multi-agent LLM system for conversational depression screening that uses algorithmic guidance (dialogue tree, consensus aggregation, cluster-based imputation) to enable an open-source model (Gemma 27B) to match or outperform a paid GPT-5-nano baseline at lower cost, ranking 2nd overall in the eRisk 2026 challenge.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种混合多智能体大语言模型系统，用于对话式抑郁筛查，通过算法指导（对话树、共识聚合、基于聚类的插补）使开源模型（Gemma 27B）在更低成本下匹配或超越付费GPT-5-nano基线，在eRisk 2026挑战中整体排名第二。
summary_zh: 我们介绍了DS@GT在eRisk 2026任务1（会话式抑郁筛查挑战）中的提交方案。在该任务中，系统需访谈模拟不同抑郁程度的LLM角色，并在不直接询问敏感心理健康问题的情况下，为每个角色生成贝克抑郁量表第二版（BDI-II）评分及四项关键症状。我们的流程经历了三个阶段：最初为单体单模型原型，随后演进为基于多智能体的基线架构——该架构在协调编排层下分离了会话访谈与BDI-II评分功能，最终采用混合配置，用开源模型Gemma 27B替换了付费的GPT-5-nano访谈模型。为弥补该模型在推理和指令遵循方面的不足，混合配置增加了三个算法组件：预计算对话树（用于标准化访谈开场白与追问）、受Weaver框架启发的可靠性加权共识聚合，以及针对未探测症状的基于聚类的插补步骤。我们提交了覆盖全部20个角色的三个全自动运行：运行1基于付费基线，运行2和运行3基于混合配置。其中混合配置的运行3取得了0.9063的ADODL值，在所有完整提交运行中排名第三，使DS@GT在全部21支队伍中位列第二，同时其每个角色的API成本约为付费基线运行1（0.8841）的四分之一，性能却优于后者。这些结果支持了我们的核心假设：在有足够算法监督的情况下，较弱的开源模型能够在会话访谈角色中与更强的专有模型竞争。我们的源代码已公开于https://github.com/dsgt-arc/erisk-task1-2026。
